title: Call vectors
description: Each vector is one call of a Board or Move function from spec/api/ with its expected outcome (E55). Values are encoded as follows: Move and every alias of an integer primitive except u64 as JSON integer, u64 and Bitboard as string 0x plus 16 lower-case hex digits, bool as JSON boolean, Board as its FEN, list<T> as array.

id.description: Unique across all files below testvectors/.

board.description: The board the method is called on: Board.from_fen(fen), then each move in order, Board.parse_move plus Board.make_move, or Board.make_null_move for 0000.

function.description: Owner and name as in spec/api/, e.g. Board.make_move.

note.description: Explanation for readers, e.g. a move value in UCI.

move.description: The Move a Move method is called on.

args.description: Arguments in the order of params.

result.description: Expected return value; null for functions without one.

result_contains.description: For results whose layout is not part of the API (Board.to_text): the returned string contains this text.

unordered.description: The result is a list whose order is not part of the API.

board_after.description: FEN of the board after the call, also after an error.
